title: Salesforce Approval Request
description: Schema for submitting, approving, or rejecting Salesforce approval process requests.

requests.description: Array of approval actions to perform.

actionType.description: The type of approval action to perform.

contextActorId.description: ID of the Salesforce user performing the action.

contextId.description: ID of the record being submitted for approval or acted upon.

comments.description: Optional comments explaining the approval decision.

nextApproverIds.description: IDs of users to assign as next approvers (for manual approver routing).

processDefinitionNameOrId.description: Name or ID of the approval process to use when submitting (for Submit actions).

skipEntryCriteria.description: Whether to skip approval process entry criteria evaluation.
